project: IgnisCore — Intelligent Fire Hazard Monitoring System
description: Multi-Source Risk Fusion Engine configuration detailing weights, category boundaries, normalization parameters, and explainable rule heuristics.

forest.description: Weight of Canadian FWI and wildland satellite/sensor ignition probability.

weather.description: Weight of atmospheric vector (relative humidity, wind velocity, ambient heat, pressure gradient).

building.description: Weight of indoor structural sensors (optical smoke obscuration, thermal sensors, electrical circuit load).

exposure.description: Weight of spatial vulnerability, flammability index of materials, occupant density, and egress distance.

levels.label: Low Risk (Normal)
levels.action_required: Routine environmental telemetry sampling; standard HVAC operation.

levels.label: Moderate / Elevated Risk
levels.action_required: Elevate telemetry polling frequency to 2000ms; verify fire dampers and corridor sensors.

levels.label: High Fire Danger
levels.action_required: Automated pre-alarm warning to safety wardens; calculate dynamic Dijkstra egress routes.

levels.label: Critical Hazard / Flashover Risk
levels.action_required: Trigger building-wide audio-visual alarms; dispatch municipal first responders; engage dynamic evacuation routing.

rules.rationale: High electrical draw coupled with elevated thermal gradient indicates imminent insulation failure.
High optical obscuration indicates smoldering or free-burning combustion.
Extreme Canadian FWI combined with gale-force winds creates uncontrollable fire propagation potential.
